note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a BLZ 10(1), 17(1); A06b BLZ 10(1), 17(1); L05 Const 27, BLZ 21(1)(f)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Belize, 2024
sources.said: Person has been ordinarily resident in Belize for 5 years immediately prior to the application, and intends to continue to do so. ... n.a. ... Person is a citizen otherwise than by birth or descent who acquires citizenship of another country.
